subject: CS360
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) across 5 topics in computer networks. For English, choices prioritized clear animations and high viewership, such as PowerCert for twisted-pair cables and Engineering Funda for fiber optics. For Arabic, selections include academic lectures from channels like 'Study with Dr. Hisham' and 'قناة الفيزياء التعليمية' to provide foundational knowledge, supplemented by popular practical explanations. All selections passed relevance, quality, duration, and view count gates, with no videos or channels duplicated within a topic.
